column1: # The sea charting drink crates' drinks: the item each crate gives, which the player then drinks (owner 2026-10-19:
# "the player just needs to get the drinks"). From the RuneLite API's public gameval names (runelite-api-1.13.1-sources.jar):
# varbit SAILING_CHARTING_DRINK_CRATE_X_COMPLETE (the task done) -> item SAILING_CHARTING_DRINK_CRATE_X. The cache's
# charting tables don't link them (table 158 only points back at the task). The Data Tool's charting export checks
# each item in the game cache.
